metadata.body:
Add a reusable exception-only `error.type` extractor and adopt it explicitly in configured-method and annotation instrumentation.

```java
.addAttributesExtractor(AttributesExtractor.errorType())
```

- **Contract:** Extract nothing on start; on end, classify a non-null terminal exception by class name after existing cause normalization. Null errors leave attributes unchanged.
- **Adoption:** Cover configured methods, modern and legacy `@WithSpan` variants, external annotations, coroutines, and Spring AOP.
- **Compatibility:** Register the fallback before more-specific extractors. Preserve global/domain defaults, asynchronous boundaries, and exception signaling.
